choices.why: No mustard velvet sofa is offered, so this warm cognac three-seater is the closest to mustard's sunny warmth and anchors the long right wall better than the black velvet option.
A natural rattan tub armchair is exactly the boho rattan seat requested and fits neatly by the balcony door.
At 335x239 cm it is large enough to sit under both the sofa and the armchair, and its blue and orange tribal pattern brings plenty of color.
The teal, mustard and blush geometric print adds the mustard note and echoes the rug, and it stands out against the cognac sofa and the rattan.
Trailing ivy spilling from the bookcase and the corners gives the lived-in, lush boho feel the user wants.
Only 43 cm high and 140 cm wide, it sits low under the back-wall window, and its wood-and-black-metal frame holds books and plants.
A 110 cm round wood table is in proportion with the sofa and the big rug, and its warm wood ties in with the parquet.
The rice paper column gives a soft, relaxed glow that suits the boho mood.
The navy geometric jacquard with fringe picks up the rug's blues and adds pattern over the sofa arm.

answer.why: Warm cognac leather, natural rattan and wood are layered with a large blue and orange rug, mustard-teal cushions, a navy patterned throw and trailing greenery, giving the bright, lived-in boho living room the user described. The catalog had no mustard velvet sofa, so the cognac leather one is a stand-in.
